scripts.prebuild: npm run prebuild:cc && npm run prebuild:gs
scripts.prebuild:cc: if [ -z "$SKIP_GENERATE_CONTENT_COLLECTIONS" ]; then npm run generate-content-collections; else echo '[IGNITION] skip content collections generate'; fi
scripts.prebuild:gs: if [ -z "$SKIP_GENERATE_IGNITION_STATICS" ]; then npm run generate-statics; else echo '[IGNITION] skip statics generate'; fi
scripts.build: if [ -z "$SKIP_IGNITION_BUILD" ]; then NODE_PATH=./node_modules GENERATE_ALL_ICONS=$GENERATE_ALL_ICONS GENERATE_SAMPLE_ICONS=$GENERATE_SAMPLE_ICONS next build; else echo '[IGNITION] skip build'; fi
scripts.predev: npm run generate-content-collections && npm run generate-statics
scripts.predev:all-icons: npm run generate-content-collections && npm run generate-statics:all-icons
scripts.generate-statics: npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register ./src/statics-generator/manifest-loader.ts && npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register ./src/statics-generator
